name: holding zero distance to the user
from: No seated office facing the user the firm's work is for, so every unit's nearest reachable party is another unit, a specification, or an aggregate — a proxy standing between the work and the person it was meant to serve.
to: A held chain-group contract to an end user, with a leading goal benchmarked against the market, so the firm's wage-payer per ren-dan-chou has an owner and nothing stands between a unit's work and the user zero distance names.
cost: Facing a user with no internal party to hide behind, and setting a target the firm may have no current idea how to reach.
otherwise: The firm's units optimize for whichever internal proxy sits nearest — a manager, a spec, an internal customer's sign-off — because zero distance was a value professed rather than a seat somebody held.
